Team — quick internal summary after an initial redline pass:

Major items (recommended positions):
- Subprocessors: Accept notification requirement, push for 30-day notice and right to object language rather than prior approval.
- Data residency / PHI: We should confirm actual processing locations. If they require hard residency guarantees (no cross-border), flag as potential pricing/ops impact. Recommend asking for a defined subset (e.g., PHI analytics storage in US) rather than global residency.
- SCCs: We can accept SCCs for EU data flows; for US health data we will rely on the DPA + HIPAA protections.
- Indemnity and liability caps: push to maintain existing RDW cap (monetary cap tied to fees) — do not concede open-ended indemnity for regulatory fines.

Action items: Neha to produce a redline with tracked changes and a short cover email to send externally. Karthik to confirm whether Dedicated/Private deployment options are on the table if residency is mandatory.
